metric: Open-source Dataform projects and BigQuery SQL, copied at pinned commits. Each project is loaded whole; every file goes through the cleanup rules and the formatter. A failure is a crash, a change accepted without a proof, a changed backticked name, or a literal ref() that is not a graph edge.
correctness: 3 failures; dependencies 402/405 literal ref() and config dependencies found
performance: 299.5 s for every project and stage
caveats: Thirteen projects only, chosen for licence and feature spread, not at random. dbt projects (Jinja) are left out because KumoSQL does not render Jinja. basedosdados is a 40-file sample of 536 near-identical view definitions, renamed after their folders because every file is called publish.sql. bigquery-utils contributes its five view files and one of its three Dataform examples (the others hold no SQL). Statement and column counts cover query models; operations and generated SQL that only running JavaScript can produce are counted as gaps, not failures. The 3 failures are refs to tables that JavaScript publishes from a query KumoSQL does not read, so they are not graph nodes. Baseline of the five projects added last, on master before the loader fixes: 35 failures, dependencies 150/185, statements 146/169, columns 924/1,006, 99 files handled; after: 3 failures, dependencies 185/188, statements 167/173, columns 1,122/1,225, 107 files handled (marketing-jumpstart reads more but is handled in 3 files, was 6, because each model it now tells apart carries a blocking gap). Three loader bugs fixed (refs and publishes with computed datasets, a when() ending with its connective, FROM inside EXTRACT read as a table). No results are compared against BigQuery. A changed statement that holds a JavaScript constant (${sp.entropy}) stays unproven until the SQLX is compiled (docs/proof-safeguards.md).
held_out: A fifth of the files, chosen by SHA-1 of project/path, scored apart: 35/58 handled, 1 with a failure (the five added projects: 15/28 handled, 1 with a failure; 14/28 and 6 at the baseline). Tuned on test: the three loader bugs were fixed with every file's failures in view, held-out files included. The first eight projects were never held out: two bugs were found and fixed on them at their first run.
